According to the comment in `pickLevel()` (router.ts, lines for the L2_L3_HYBRID case):

The range was **widened from 6-15 to 3-15 tokens**.

The comment explains the rationale:
> "Widened from 6-15 so short natural-language questions get semantic recall (via RRF fusion with keyword search) instead of being stuck keyword-only."

This change allows 3-5 token queries (like "how does auth work") to reach semantic search via the L2_L3_HYBRID hybrid path, rather than being routed to keyword-only L2.
